scope: Malformed cache relocation values remain inert at startup
guarantees: Only nonempty string paths without embedded NUL enter normalized relocation records.
Non-mapping JSON top levels stay inert.
Explicit external environment variables remain authoritative.
Reading/applying metadata does not modify its raw bytes.
limitations: No cache directories moved/deleted; all fixtures native temporary files and process environment.
No UI, captions, models, network, GPU or full CI.
